title: Telemetry followup event
description: One follow-up work item emitted from an envelope-out's `followups[]` (see envelope-out.json, common.json#/$defs/followup). loadout's ingest helper (clagentic_loadout.telemetry.emitter.emit_followup_events) emits exactly one of these records per followup entry, to whatever sink the deployment has configured. This record carries no task-tracker semantics -- no tracker ID, no assignee, no status. Turning a followup event into a tracked task (or ignoring it) is entirely a deployment concern (CLAUDE.md hard rule 6a); loadout's job ends at emitting this typed record. additionalProperties:false, mechanical whitelist.

task_id.description: The opaque work-item ref of the invocation that produced this followup (envelope-out.json's task_id), carried through unchanged. null when the source envelope omitted task_id.

agent_name.description: The agent/role that produced this followup (envelope-out.json's agent_name), carried through unchanged.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the emitter recorded this event.

followup.description: The followup descriptor itself (matches common.json#/$defs/followup). Carried as an opaque object at this layer, same convention as telemetry-trace-event.json's envelope field -- the emitter trusts the caller already validated the source envelope via clagentic_loadout.envelope before emitting.
